subject: Order Form language: technical attestation for DPA & hosting assumptions
messages:
From: Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@evergreenhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aleksei Petrov <alek.petrov@whiteoaklaw.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on DPA attestation + hosting assumptions for Order Form

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we have internal legal & security follow-ups before we can finish procurement. Two items they asked me to clarify:

1) Technical attestation: our security team needs a short, signed attestation in the DPA that the customer-managed key (CMK) option for encryption at rest is supported when the service is deployed in Evergreen's private environment (VPC/on-prem). They asked for suggested wording we can include in the Order Form or DPA.

2) Hosting assumptions: the Order Form lists "Private deployment" and "Dedicated capacity" options but legal wants a brief paragraph that clarifies which features (CMK, HSM-backed KMS, audit-log retention, and egress controls) are available for each deployment model. They prefer that be part of the Order Form, not a separate SOW.

I've attached Evergreen_DPA_questions.pdf with the related security checklist. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) provide the attestation language, (b) confirm the limits (e.g., CMK only for Private), and (c) propose where that language should live (Order Form vs. DPA)?

If helpful, Aleksei (copied) is Evergreen's counsel and can redline suggested text. We need this resolved by end of next week to stay on the Q2 procurement timeline.

Best,
Nadia
Senior Procurement Manager
Evergreen Health

Hi Nadia — thanks for the clear summary and the checklist. We're able to respond but need to coordinate legal + infra to ensure the wording matches our deployment capabilities.

Next steps from our side:
- I've looped in Ben (Contracts) and Karthik (Privacy & Risk) to draft proposed language for both a DPA attestation snippet and an Order Form hosting-assumptions paragraph.
- Ben / Karthik: can you propose two short options (1) narrow attestation for Private deployments only and (2) broader hosting-assumptions paragraph that maps CMK/HSM/audit to Dedicated vs Private?
- We'll also surface any operational constraints (e.g., KMS integration timelines, HSM availability in specific regions).

Nadia — if Evergreen has a preference for where the language should live (Order Form vs. DPA), please advise. Otherwise we'll propose both and indicate our recommended placement.

Ben/Karthik — target to share draft language by EOD Tuesday (2026-06-02). If you hit any blockers on technical feasibility, flag to Irene (cc'd on my follow-up) who can pull infra engineers into a quick call.

Thanks,
Laura
VP, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed redline language for Evergreen — attestation + hosting mapping

Laura / Karthik — per our ask, drafted two concise options below. I also noted operational caveats so legal has a record. I've attached a redline (redline_orderform_v1.docx) with both snippets placed where the Order Form typically captures feature-level assumptions.

--- Option A: DPA attestation (narrow) ---
"Redwood hereby attests that, when Customer elects the Private deployment option in the Order Form and provides Customer-managed encryption keys via its supported KMS provider, Redwood's Private deployment supports the use of Customer-managed keys (CMKs) for encryption of customer data at rest. This attestation is limited to Private deployments and does not apply to Redwood's multi-tenant hosted offering or standard Dedicated pools unless explicitly stated in the Order Form."

Operational caveat: CMK/HSM integration requires customer KMS configuration and network connectivity (VPC peering or direct link). For Evergreen, if the deployment is on-prem, provisioning lead time is typically 3-6 weeks after KMS access is provided.

--- Option B: Order Form hosting-assumptions paragraph (mapping) ---
"Hosting assumptions: For clarity, the Order Form below maps key security features to deployment models. 'Private deployment' (Customer-managed VPC or on-prem package): supports CMK for data-at-rest encryption, HSM-backed KMS integrations where available, configurable audit-log retention up to 12 months, and customer-controlled egress rules. 'Dedicated capacity' (single-tenant Redwood-managed GPU pool): supports customer isolation and configurable audit-log retention; CMK support is available only when deployment is provisioned as Private under a separate Order Form addendum. 'Hosted API' (multi-tenant): CMK/HSM options are not available; encryption is managed by Redwood."

Operational caveat: HSM-backed KMS is limited to select regions and Private/on-prem packages only. If Evergreen needs HSM in a specific region, we should confirm availability early.

Recommended approach: include Option B as a short mapping in the Order Form and include Option A as a cross-reference snippet in the DPA that points to the Order Form section. That gives Evergreen contractual clarity in the purchase docs while keeping DPA-level attestations auditable.

Attachments: redline_orderform_v1.docx (contains copy/paste-ready snippets). Also included a plain text file DPA_Attestation_snippet.txt with the attestation language formatted for insertion.

If that looks good I'll prepare a DocuSign-ready Order Form + one-page DPA attestation exhibit.

Ben
Senior Contracts Manager
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@evergreenhealth.com>, Aleksei Petrov <alek.petrov@whiteoaklaw.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T16:51:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA attestation + hosting assumptions for Order Form

Nadia / Aleksei — thanks for your patience. Attached is our proposed package (Evergreen_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx) plus a short DPA attestation snippet (DPA_Attestation_snippet.txt). Summary of what we're proposing: 

- Order Form paragraph (hosting-assumptions): maps CMK/HSM/audit retention/egress to Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted. This is the primary place to capture feature availability.
- DPA attestation snippet: one short sentence that commits Redwood to support CMK for Customer's Private deployment when properly configured; explicitly limited to Private deployments.
- Operational notes: CMK/HSM integration requires KMS credentials and VPC connectivity. Typical provisioning lead time: 3-6 weeks after credentials and network access are provided. If Evergreen needs HSM in a specific cloud region, call that out now so we can validate capacity.

Requested next steps from Evergreen:
1) Please confirm whether Evergreen prefers the attestation in the DPA (we recommend cross-referencing the Order Form paragraph) or in the Order Form itself. 
2) If Evergreen accepts the language, confirm a target sign-by date so Ben can send DocuSign. We can have a Docusign package ready within 48 hours of written approval. (DocuSign package: https://docusign.com/doc/EVG-0423-orderform-redline)

Quoting internal draft for context:
> "Redwood hereby attests that, when Customer elects the Private deployment option in the Order Form and provides Customer-managed encryption keys via its supported KMS provider, Redwood's Private deployment supports the use of Customer-managed keys (CMKs) for encryption of customer data at rest..."

Irene, if you or infra would like to confirm the lead-time estimate for Evergreen's environment, please reply here and we can loop infra into a short call.

Nadia — happy to hop on a 20-minute alignment call if Evergreen's security team prefers to walk through the operational caveats.

Best,
Laura
VP, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
